ServicePackage.title: ServicePackage
ServicePackage.description: Represents an AC service item with image graphic index, service name, and price in INR, managed by the admin (coolbrosacservice@gmail.com) and displayed publicly on the website.

name.description: Display title of the AC service.

tagline.description: Short subtitle or description of the service.

iconIndex.description: Index of the service illustration graphic (0 to 5).

updatedByEmail.description: Verified email of the admin who created or updated this service.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the service was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the service was last updated.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents an AC servicing, repair, gas charging, or installation appointment booked by an authenticated customer.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who owns this booking.

customerPhone.description: Contact phone number for service dispatch.

customerEmail.description: Verified email address of the customer.

serviceAddress.description: Complete street address and landmark for technician visit.

unitCount.description: Number of AC units included in the booking (1 to 20).

scheduledDate.description: Scheduled service date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

notes.description: Optional special instructions or cooling symptoms.

technicianName.description: Assigned Cool Bros lead technician name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was last updated.

MaintenanceReminder.title: MaintenanceReminder
MaintenanceReminder.description: Tracks an installed AC unit and its upcoming preventive maintenance reminder schedule for a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

unitLabel.description: Room or location label for the AC unit (e.g. Master Bedroom Split AC).

lastServicedDate.description: Date of most recent service in YYYY-MM-DD format.

nextDueDate.description: Date of next recommended preventive service in YYYY-MM-DD format.

intervalMonths.description: Recommended maintenance cadence in months (3, 4, 6, or 12).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when unit tracker was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when unit tracker was last updated.

CustomerMessage.title: CustomerMessage
CustomerMessage.description: Represents a direct inquiry message sent from the app and forwarded via email to coolbrosacservice@gmail.com.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who sent the message.

senderName.description: Full name of the customer sending the message.

senderPhone.description: Contact phone number of the sender.

senderEmail.description: Verified email address of the sender.

messageText.description: Body of the message sent to Cool Bros AC Service.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

CustomerReview.title: CustomerReview
CustomerReview.description: Public customer review and star rating submitted by either a signed-in user or a guest customer.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reviewer, or 'guest' when submitted without sign-in.

authorName.description: Display name of the customer leaving the review.

isVerifiedUser.description: True if submitted by a Google-authenticated user, false for guest submissions.

locality.description: Customer locality or sector (e.g., Sector 62, Noida).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when review was submitted.

/services/{serviceId}.description: Stores AC services and live pricing configured by the admin (coolbrosacservice@gmail.com) and publicly readable by all visitors.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Stores customer AC service bookings, isolated strictly to the authenticated owner or admin.

/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Stores customer AC equipment profiles and upcoming maintenance reminder schedules, isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores customer inquiry messages sent from the app and emailed to coolbrosacservice@gmail.com.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Stores public customer reviews and ratings submitted with or without sign-in.
